name: easel
description: Design screens as plain HTML on a live canvas: the Easel MCP tools and a skill that knows the loop (claim, write, check tokens, screenshot, comment)

interface.shortDescription: A design canvas for your HTML screens
interface.longDescription: Easel shows the screens/*.html files in your repo as boards on a live canvas. The plugin adds the Easel MCP tools and a skill for designing, comparing and reviewing screens with the person watching the canvas.
defaultPrompt: Open the design canvas for this project
Make three variants of the sign-up screen side by side
Fix what I selected on the canvas
